issue.title: Add an option to pin columns in the table
issue.body:
### Description

It would be great if `UTable` had a `pinned` option per column, so the first column stays visible while the rest scrolls horizontally. Right now this needs custom CSS on every table.

### Additional context

Most data grid libraries ship this. Happy to open a pull request if the API is agreed on.
